conventions.codon: CodonCells.lean: U=0 C=1 A=2 G=3, first base bits 4-5 (chosen bijection)
conventions.hexagram: bit i = line i+1 from the bottom, 1 = solid (chosen bijection)
conventions.tone: RA sector -> major-scale degree, declination band -> octave (A2..A5)
conventions.colour: hue = RA sector, lightness = declination band, saturation = brightness

solar_system.note: Titius-Bode a = 0.4 + 0.3 * 2^n is an empirical rule.  Its n = 3 slot (2.8 AU) is occupied by the asteroid belt (Ceres 2.77 AU).  The belt's total mass is a few percent of the Moon's, and the idea that it is a broken-up planet (Olbers) is not supported; Jupiter's resonances are the accepted reason no planet formed there.  The rule fails for Neptune (30.1 vs 38.8 AU).
